tools.name: geocode_forward
tools.description: Forward geocode a place name or address with Mapbox (returns matching places with coordinates)

query.description: Place name or address to search for (e.g. 10 Downing Street, London)

country.description: Optional comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to limit results to (e.g. gb,ie)

types.description: Optional comma-separated feature types to limit results to (e.g. address,place,postcode)

tools.name: geocode_reverse
tools.description: Reverse geocode a longitude and latitude with Mapbox (returns the places containing that point)

types.description: Optional comma-separated feature types to limit results to (e.g. address,place,postcode)

tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: List the Mapbox styles owned by one account (style id, name, visibility and modified time)

username.description: Mapbox account username that owns the styles (e.g. mapbox)

tools.name: get_driving_directions
tools.description: Get a Mapbox driving route between waypoints (distance, duration and per-leg summary)

needs_review: Tools added 2026-09-12 from the official Mapbox API reference (Geocoding v5 https://docs.mapbox.com/api/search/geocoding-v5/, Styles https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/styles/, Directions v5 https://docs.mapbox.com/api/navigation/directions/): all four are GET reads, no write tool is declared.

No token-management tool is declared. The Tokens API (/tokens/v2/{username}) returns token metadata, so exposing it as an agent tool would put credential material in tool output; it is deliberately out of scope.

The scaffolded test path /tokens/v2 was replaced with a documented Geocoding v5 read. Evidence: /tokens/v2 with an invalid token answers HTTP 200 with body {"code":"TokenMalformed"}, so it cannot distinguish a working credential from a broken one, and it is a token endpoint (see above). The geocoding read answers 401 {"message":"Not Authorized - Invalid Token"} with a dummy token and 200 with a real one.
The scaffolded query auth (access_token query parameter) is unchanged: it is what every Mapbox endpoint above documents and what the live 401 bodies confirm.

Geocoding v5 is Mapbox's long-standing endpoint and remains live; Mapbox also ships a newer Geocoding v6 (/search/geocode/v6/forward). If v5 is retired, these two tools move to v6 paths, which have a different response envelope.

_probe hints are public values only: the Mapbox-owned username 'mapbox' for style listing and public central-London coordinates for the reverse-geocode and directions routes, because a dummy string cannot route those paths.
